old_value.title: Frozen checkout's mixed-case official repository rejects its own prebuilt releases
old_value.behavior: The frozen old checkout compares a lowercased canonical repository against a mixed-case official repository constant, rejecting the nominal official CLI manifest before staging.
old_value.technical_explanation: canonical_repository lowercases owner/repository, while REPOSITORY contains Zyk-Void. The same mixed-case constant is passed to release-asset URL validation, so the expected identity must be corrected consistently at both boundaries.
old_value.assumptions: Bounded to the frozen old Rust checkout and nominal official manifest. Active-checkout behavior must be revalidated during final relocation; no download or runtime test was executed. Do not attribute this defect to upstream without Git evidence.
old_value.parity_relation: Overlaps the cited parity entry and records a concrete native correctness or reliability defect separately from an architectural difference.
old_value.provenance: The local rebrand commit 8af1c0578d0f4cbfa0c6d142a74ad668b85f95eb replaced the lowercase upstream repository https://github.com/bigfish1913/pi-rust with mixed-case https://github.com/Zyk-Void/ice-rust while retaining the lowercase canonical comparison. The exact local Git rename/diff is preserved in evidence/rust-prebuilt-rebrand-defect.json. This defect is not attributed to upstream. Active-checkout correction remains a final relocation check.

provenance_review.method: Read local rename-aware Git diff plus current canonical_repository and caller source. The changed constant is the behavioral difference, not merely a presumed mechanical rename.
